# Example data

The five demo-*.csv files are synthetic cohorts generated by the package's
example-data functions. demo-data.txt records row counts, seeds, identifiers
and time units. The generator is examples/regenerate-demo-data.R.

Use these datasets for the runnable tutorials and input-format examples.
No study patients are supplied.

unified_pipeline_registry_1213_20260806.csv is a historical candidate registry.
Its catalog-only entries do not establish executable support. Use models()
and the current model catalog for supported configurations and dependencies.
